findings.current_text: {jobs, plural, one {# जॉब} other {# जॉब}} की प्रतीक्षा में
findings.problem: Plural जॉब is not inflected for the oblique case required by की प्रतीक्षा में.
findings.evidence: Runtime renders 2 जॉब की प्रतीक्षा में; Hindi consonant-final masculine nouns need the plural oblique -ों before की. The Hindi style guide explicitly requires natural plural obliques; existing wire.settings.providers_anthropic_cache_ttl_1h_min_context_tokens.help uses उप-एजेंटों की. Counts 2, 5, 21 and 1000000 take other; one covers 0 and 1 per the repository rule.
